qualificationBasis.decision: The maintainer confirmed that Pi was validated without blocking issues on Windows x64 and approved its release without experimental disclosure.
qualificationBasis.rawEvidencePolicy: Credentials, prompts, machine paths, Native Session identifiers, and raw target-host logs are intentionally excluded from the repository.

runtimeEvidence.authentication: Pi official minimax-cn configuration with MiniMax-M3
runtimeEvidence.sessionStrategy: resident_multi_session with exact private Session-file switch and full-ID verification

acceptance.realModel: MiniMax-M3 returned the expected answer through the installed Core
acceptance.coldContinuation: the exact Native Session was restored after Host restart and retained prior conversation facts
acceptance.nativeTools: file write and Bash output completed through native Pi tools
acceptance.plannedShutdown: the isolated Core shutdown completed and reaped its Pi host
acceptance.machineAndExecutionBoundary: ordinary machine readiness, model, installation, session, and dispatch checks remain mandatory after platform admission

limitations: Credentials, prompts, machine paths, Native Session identifiers, Run identifiers, and raw host logs are intentionally excluded.
External MCP, structured Web Search, and Camp Fast remain unsupported or hidden exactly as documented; platform qualification does not add those capabilities.
Pi skill discovery remains owned by the native ResourceLoader and workspace trust rather than a Rovai catalog attestation.
Usage retains only terminal assistant token evidence; unreported reasoning and cost remain unknown.
